angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 52,247,070 km at 44678.30 pc = 0.02 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 2282: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 44678.3 +/- 1790.5 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 44678.3 +/- 1790.5 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax -0.0094 +/- 0.0143 mas (same row, RUWE 1.18), -0.7 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 75.1 +/- 2.9 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 2282: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 75.1 +/- 2.9 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 52,247,070 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5250 +/- 168 K from Groenewegen & Lub (2023), A&A 676, A136, VizieR J/A+A/676/A136/table1, Name=LMC0683, columns Teffp, e_Teffp: Teff 5250 +/- 168 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07559). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen & Lub (2023), A&A 676, A136, VizieR J/A+A/676/A136/table1, Name=LMC0683, columns Teffp, e_Teffp: Teff 5250 +/- 168 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07559)
surfaceGravitySource: log g 0.4 from 2022A&A...658A..29R; the 3 published values span log g 0.4 to 2.78, across which the limb law changes by at most 2.8% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A%26A...658A..29R)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
